title: Copy phase of the prefix emitter
statement: Let $w,x$ be Boolean words. For every natural number $i\le |x|$, after $i$ steps from the configuration in control state $|w|$, with input head at position $1$ and output $w$, the machine remains in control state $|w|$, has input head at position $i+1$, and has output $w$ followed by the first $i$ symbols of $x$.
replaced:
For every $i \le \abs{x}$, after $i$ steps from the configuration in which the
whole fixed word $w$ has been emitted and the input head sits at the start of
$x$, the prefix emitter has advanced the input head by $i$ cells and its
output is $w$ followed by the first $i$ bits of $x$.
